name: Fichtensee Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung: Snack stand at Lake Fichtensee on the Rosenalm high above Zell am Ziller – snacks and treats for a light appetite.
beschreibung: The Fichtensee lies on the Rosenalm at around 1,700 metres above sea level, high above Zell am Ziller in the Zillertal. It is part of the Fichtenwelt of the Zillertal Arena and easy to reach from Zell am Ziller with the Rosenalmbahn cable car. In summer the lake serves as a swimming lake with a viewing platform, boat and stand-up paddle hire, diving boards and the shallow Wichtelbucht for the little ones; in winter it is used as a storage pond for snowmaking. On the lakeshore, a snack van takes care of your well-being and offers snacks and treats for a little hunger in between. All around, cosy niches, swings and the buggy-friendly Fichtenweg invite you to linger. Nearby is also the Fichtenschloss, a large adventure playground for families.
